prompt_lines: Preserve the fine mist sprayer actuator, nozzle face, collar, cap state, trim finish, and visible internal dip tube if present in the reference.

White, clear, translucent, or pale cap/actuator/over-cap surfaces must remain visible against the Bone background: preserve rim ellipse, top lip, sidewall edges, nozzle face, subtle edge density, tiny highlights, and local contact separation.
Preserve the roller ball plug, over-cap state, cap color, ball seat, neck fit, and cap scale.
If cap-off, the bottle top shows the exposed roller plug only, and the matching over-cap sits upright to the right on the same baseline.
Preserve the dropper collar, rubber bulb, pipette geometry if visible, cap color, and seated relationship to the bottle neck.
Do not add sprayer, hose, tassel, or roller components.
Preserve pump/actuator geometry, nozzle direction, collar, cap state, and visible dip tube if present.
Keep pale plastic pump details readable with edge separation.
Preserve the atomizer sprayer top, sleeve/cap transitions, actuator geometry, and opaque metal shell relationship.
Do not expose a transparent bottle interior through an atomizer shell.
Preserve bulb, hose, tassel if present, collar, trim, textile color, and full component visibility.
Keep hose and tassel inside the safe zone with tactile fabric/rubber detail.
Preserve the reducer insert, drop-control opening, neck finish, closure state, and small aperture geometry.
Do not replace the reducer with a dropper, pump, sprayer, or roller.
Preserve splash closure or open-neck state exactly as shown, including thread finish and cap placement.
Do not add a pump, sprayer, dropper, roller, hose, or tassel.
Preserve lotion pump head, stem, collar, direction, height, and seated relationship to the bottle.
Keep pump edges readable, especially white or pale plastic parts.
Preserve screw cap height, diameter, color, finish, thread relationship, and cap state.
Pale caps must retain visible sidewalls, top ellipse, and edge separation against Bone.
Do not add a closure, cap, pump, sprayer, dropper, roller, or decorative applicator unless visible in the reference.
